meta.text: Use the Spark UI to read task counts, executor utilization, spill, and GC time — those are the signals that tell you the real worker count you need. Note the second habit: always set auto-termination on all-purpose clusters, typically ten to thirty minutes, and run scheduled work on job clusters, which carry a lower DBU rate. And for fault-tolerant batch workloads, use spot instances for the workers, but keep the driver and any SLA-critical work on on-demand nodes.
